## Independent reviewer reproduction

```powershell
$env:NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED = '1'
$env:PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE = '1'
corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
corepack pnpm exec vitest run tests/unit/world-subsystems.test.ts
corepack pnpm run ci
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short --branch
```

Pass means the focused suite reports 6/6, full CI reports 84/84 and exits `0`, governance reports 7/7, diff check has no errors, and only the documented Prompt 10 plus preserved Prompt 09 acceptance paths are changed. Passing does not mark PB2-10 ACCEPTED.

## Diff summary

The change replaces generic world/institution envelopes with strict canonical state ownership, adds atomic canonical effect application and deterministic traces, and provides opt-in ordered fixture resolvers for conflict, civilian, infrastructure, and development. It adds no real values, production formula, spontaneous effect, or external-environment mutation.
